description_for_human: Free Australian property data API. Calculates stamp duty for all states, LMI, mortgage ceilings, repayments, and suburb realism scores.
description_for_model: GetReal Property API provides Australian property calculations including: stamp duty for all 8 states and territories (with FHB concessions), LMI estimates, monthly repayment calculations, mortgage ceiling calculators (deposit floor, DTI cap, serviceability), and suburb realism scores showing what share of a suburb's market is within a given budget. Data sourced from NSW Valuer General (146,000+ individual sale records) and Victorian Valuer General quarterly reports. All endpoints are GET with query parameters. No authentication required.
